title: kbmon's sessions panel lists dispatch runs from the claims ledger's worker pid and session
goal: the sessions panel lists each dispatch run of this clone (item, worker pid, worker session, alive or ended) from the worker_pid and worker_session dispatch records, so a dead worker shows beside the live ones

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,time
def k(*a,env=None):
    t0=time.time();p=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbmon.py',*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=env or os.environ,timeout=120);p.wall=time.time()-t0
    if p.returncode not in (0,1): print('kbmon exit',p.returncode,p.stderr[-300:]);sys.exit(1)
    return p
d=json.loads(k('--json','--panel','sessions').stdout)['panels']['sessions']['data']
print(list(d));sys.exit(0 if 'dispatch' in d else 1)
